panel1605609343246.jcr:title: Acknowledgement regarding regulatory disclosure and confirmation on non-solicitation
panel1605609343246.name: Step_Acknowledgement

textdraw._value:
I/We hereby

  • acknowledge being informed that UBS Switzerland AG is not authorized to publicly offer intermediary services1 in Costa Rica. As a result, UBS Switzerland AG is not subject to the oversight or regulation of the Costa Rican General Superintendence for Securities, and
  • confirm that the services to be provided have been expressly requested by me/us, without any referral or solicitation from an intermediary. Consequently, no public offering or solicitation for such services has been made within Costa Rica.
textdraw.name: ST_I_We

textdraw_1221932865._value: 1 Under Costa Rican law "trading of securities" is an activity commonly carried out by stock brokerage firms and regulated banks with the aim of putting in contact buyers and sellers of securities, such as (i) buying and selling of securities directly for the clients (as principal or agent), (ii) obtaining and granting loans to clients, if the loans are directly related to securities transactions, (iii) offering and providing of security advice or recommendations, (iv) providing asset management services for individual clients, (v) the marketing and sale of products related to securities, and (vi) the underwriting and placing of products related to securities. These activities fall within the concept of "Intermediary Services and Complementary Activities".
textdraw_1221932865.name: footNoteText

panel1605609343246_c.name: Step_Applicable

textdraw._value:
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with substantive Swiss law.

Subject to mandatory jurisdictions provided by law the exclusive place of jurisdiction for all legal proceedings shall be Zurich or the location of the branch holding the account.

This shall also be the place of performance, and the place of debt collection for clients domiciled abroad
textdraw.name: ST_Agreement

textdraw_2125542850._value: By signing below, I confirm my understanding and agreement to the above terms.
